messages:
sara_fin: FYI SpectraCloud (acct 7682) flagged as overdue. Sent dunning #2 today — they replied and asked if we can do a short installment plan.
omar_collections: Can you paste the outstanding invoice and current balance?
sara_fin: Sure, summary below:
```
Invoice: INV-2026-7682
Due date: 2026-03-01
Total due: $137,450.00
Outstanding balance: $137,450.00
Late fees applied: $1,250.00
Last payment attempt: 2026-03-08 (card declined)
```
liam_account_mgr: I talked to their PM earlier. They say an ACH is pending but cashflow tight this month. Offered 3-installment plan over 60 days. Asked we hold service cutoff until next Monday.
ana_support: (note) no active support tickets from SpectraCloud. Usage pattern unchanged.
billing-bot: Automated: Next ACH retry scheduled for 2026-03-15 09:00 UTC. If retry fails, move to dunning stage 3.
omar_collections: Proposed plan: 1) $50k on 3/15, 2) $50k on 4/15, 3) remainder (~$37,450) on 5/15. We can waive the $1,250 late fee if they sign the payment agreement and make the first payment on 3/15. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
lina_cfo: Approve waiving late fee conditional on (a) signed payment agreement, (b) first installment cleared by 2026-03-16, and (c) credit card/ACH mandate on file. Legal to prepare docs. :white_check_mark:
legal-ops: I'll draft a short installment agreement and include default terms (service suspend + collections after one missed payment). Need PO number and SOW reference.
liam_account_mgr: PO 9933, SOW-77 (SpectraCloud onboarding). I'll attach the SOW to the thread and loop in their billing contact.
sara_fin: I'll set internal dunning hold so Cutoff = ON HOLD until 2026-03-22 pending cleared payment. If payment not received by 3/16, we'll revert to original cutoff schedule and notify.
omar_collections: Good. I'll send the payment plan email now and copy legal. Will cc: lina_cfo.
liam_account_mgr: Sending to SpectraCloud billing contact (cc'ing product PM) now — will update thread after they sign. :thumbsup:
sara_fin: Thanks — once signed, I'll update ledger and remove late fee. Also creating a note to stop automated stage-3 email while agreement is under review.
legal-ops: Draft uploaded to /legal/drafts/spectracloud_installment_1852506789.docx — please review.
liam_account_mgr: Reviewed, small wording tweak on payment dates. Pushed update.
omar_collections: Confirming target: first payment by 2026-03-15, otherwise escalate to collections on 2026-03-16.
sara_fin: Marking as in-progress. Will post final status here after payment or signed agreement.
liam_account_mgr: @SpectraCloud-billing (billing@spectracloud.com) — we sent the installment proposal. Please confirm receipt.
(reacts: :eyes: from lina_cfo, :wave: from liam_account_mgr)
